settings.title: Telephony (CTI)
settings.description: Pop incoming calls on screen and keep a call log — any PBX via webhook.

telephony.defaultCountryHelp: Two-letter country code used to interpret local phone numbers (e.g. ES).
telephony.webhookHelp: Configure your PBX or Zapier to POST normalized call events to this URL, signed with the secret.
telephony.secretShownOnce: Copy this secret now — it is shown only once. Your PBX/automation signs each event with it (X-DentalPin-Signature).
